central_rule: Never include target-game outcomes or future-event statistics. Historical event features require completed prior games, chronological order and source traceability, not publication timestamps of retrospective files. Point-in-time context requires evidence of the version available at cutoff. The explicit phase3-calendar-v1 exception permits only historical schedule identity/calendar fields and rest, as a marked approximation; it does not cover market, weather, injuries, inactives, roster, news or QB.
population: Retrospectively observed kicker participation; conditional on participation, not an automatic starter prediction. Training eligibility remains unapproved.
history_scope: Same-season GLOBAL kicker_id across teams; REG and postseason together. Rolling requires exactly 3/5 previous available observations; no cross-season or future fill.
